Application Support DevOps Engineer 
Mission 

Ensure the proper administration, stability, and optimal functioning of applications and services within the assigned technical area. Act as an effective communication link between internal teams and external stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

Administer and monitor IT applications and solutions. 
Resolve incidents in a timely manner for applications within scope. 
Maintain application stability, perform upgrades and apply security patches. 
Participate as an active member in project teams. 
Regularly assess the health of deployed components and take or recommend corrective actions. 
Create and maintain documentation for procedures related to administered IT solutions. 
Perform testing activities for applications under support. 
Provide consultancy and technical assistance for applications in scope. 

Required Technical Skills

Administration of Java and HTTP application servers. 
Advanced knowledge of Windows, Linux/UNIX operating systems. 
Experience with databases: Oracle, SQL, RDS, PostgreSQL. 
Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure). 
Basic understanding of Artificial Intelligence and ability to use AI tools. 
Experience with Web Services: APIs, SOAP, REST. 
Knowledge of integration concepts (message queues, web services, SCA, databases, etc.). 
Issue tracking tools (optional): Jira. 
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. 
Automation tools: Git, Gradle, Jenkins, Artifactory. 
Tools: Toad, SQL Developer, IBM Data Studio, IBM MQ Explorer, ODI, SFTP clients. 
Containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift. 
Familiarity with CI/CD concepts, microservices, web services, ELK stack. 
Ability to develop or enhance CI/CD pipelines for modern and legacy systems. 
Automation‑driven mindset. 
Basic understanding of AI with openness to developing advanced knowledge. 

Benefits

Fun and collaborative working environment When we say “collaborative,” we truly mean it. We are open to new ideas and initiatives and value everyone’s contribution.
Competitive compensation We believe remuneration is a basic and essential element, which is why we offer competitive salaries aligned with market standards and your level of expertise.
Holiday Starting from 23 days of paid leave, increasing up to 27 days per year based on your professional experience.
13th salary We offer a 13th salary, granted after completing the first year with the company.
Annual performance bonus As we consistently deliver high-quality work on time, RBI & RBRO also offers an annual performance bonus.
Group insurance Collective insurance coverage provided through Uniqa.
Flexible benefits account Monthly benefits budget, including meal vouchers and additional options.
Personal development & career plan Individual development and career plan, with up to 2 days per month dedicated exclusively to personal and professional growth.
Private pension – Pillar III Private pension contribution (Pillar III) via Raiffeisen Leasing.
Private medical health insurance
Volunteering events
Team-building activities

Candidate Profile 

3–5 years of experience in application support or development. 
Fast learner, motivated to stay up to date with new technologies. 
Strong communication skills. 
Advanced knowledge of the skills required for the role.


Desired Skills and Experience
Java, SQL, Linux, Jenkins, Microsoft Azure, Artificial Intelligence, Unix
